task: #27 P9.C1 compact MoE + Q8_0 WMMA prefill tile sweep
summary: P9.C1 selected-MoE/Q8_0 WMMA tuning retained partial improvements but missed the <=110 ms combined WMMA bucket gate. Best retained default: Q4_K selected dual 32x16, Q5_K/Q6_K selected down legacy 16x16, Q8_0 shared gate+up dual concat WMMA at 16x32 plus single Q8_0 out>=4096 heuristic. Combined Q4 dual + Q5/Q6 down + Q8_0 WMMA bucket is 149.03 ms (target <=110 ms), down from 170.41 ms after P9.A3/P9.C1 partial (~12.5%). Launch-bounds min-block sweep (1/2/4/8) was also run after adding a compile-time sweep knob; min-blocks=2 remains retained because 1/4/8 did not improve 512/0 wall time.

notes: single-csv mode: only the prefill phase is reported. Pass --decode-csv (paired with --prefill-csv) to also report a decode phase.

q4_k_selected_dual.reason: best retained qwen35moe rocprof result; 58.56 ms vs ~65.66 ms legacy under Q8 dual

q5_k_selected_down.reason: multi-tile variants were slower in E2E sweeps

q6_k_selected_down.reason: multi-tile variants were slower in E2E sweeps

q8_0_shared_gate_up_dual.reason: dual concat path; reduces Q8_0 dispatches 250 -> 170

q8_0_single_out_ge_4096.reason: P9.C1 microbench: shared-expert single out=4096 ~2x faster than 32x32

selected_launch_bounds_min_blocks.reason: P9.C1 launch-bounds sweep retained the P8 __launch_bounds__(32,2) hint.

launch_bounds_sweep.reason: min-blocks=2 is the fastest single-run setting and matches the legacy P8 launch-bound hint; min-blocks=1 gives no benefit, while 4/8 are slower.

acceptance.reason: Combined WMMA bucket 149.03 ms > 110 ms target. Remaining gap is ~39 ms; multi-tile selected kernels reduce dispatch/block count but increase register pressure and are slower except Q4_K 32x16. Further gains likely require a different selected-MoE kernel design/repack/sidecar or splitting by expert occupancy, not the current raw generic TM/TN path. A follow-up launch-bounds sweep retained min-blocks=2; it does not close the remaining gap.
